rows.text: There he is! Lord Dan Heng!
rows.speaker: Zeph the Guard

rows.text: Quick! We must assist him!
rows.speaker: Mnemosyne the Guard

rows.text: ...[Trailblazer]!? What are you doing here? Where's Phainon?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We are under Lord Phainon's orders to escort both of you to safety, no matter the cost!
rows.speaker: Mnemosyne the Guard

rows.text: Leave this to me and the Holy City Guards... Zeph, take them and go!
rows.speaker: Mnemosyne the Guard

rows.text: Wait, Mnemosyne—
rows.speaker: Zeph the Guard

rows.text: That black-clad swordmaster... something seems off.
rows.speaker: Zeph the Guard

rows.text: At some point earlier, they suddenly froze in place... not moving at all.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Like... some kind of omen.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Now's our chance to take them down!
No time to waste, let's get out of here.
No, don't get too close! That thing's black flames are burning hot. I don't know what's happening, but leaving is the best option.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Right. We don't know exactly what's happening, but retreating is the safest choice right now.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I don't know which demigod graced us with this miracle... Please, come with us!
rows.speaker: Zeph the Guard

rows.text: Phainon... is he going to be alright?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Believe in his resolve to save Okhema.
rows.speaker: Zeph the Guard

rows.text: It was fortunate we found you in time. Madam Herta and I were both quite relieved, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Indeed. Madam Herta invited me to meet with you Nameless. Rest assured, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Rest assured, [Trailblazer]. Madam Herta and I have come here for the sake of Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: [Trailblazer], don't get too close!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That thing's black flames are extremely dangerous.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Flame Reaver isn't pursuing us... Could this really be some kind of divine intervention?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We can't stay here for long. Lady Trinnon's Century Gate is just outside the city — let's keep moving.
rows.speaker: Mnemosyne the Guard

rows.text: I still feel like someone should stay behind...
Is this... really what Trailblazing is supposed to be?
Leaving like this... I'll definitely regret it.
I agree. But Phainon... he must have struggled a lot before making this decision.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Our experience in Amphoreus has far exceeded expectations. If our goal was just to replenish fuel, then mission accomplished. But you're right...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I... feel the same. Someone should stay and help Phainon complete Era Nova.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: For now, let's get back in contact with the Express and plan our next move. That's the safest course of action. We need more information.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: On that note, I have a proposal—
...Who's there!?
rows.speaker: Zeph the Guard

rows.text: I hope to convey a message to the two "Nameless."
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Well... I stand corrected. An outsider like {M#him}{F#her} does have ways to defy destiny.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The world will be moved by your sacrifice, Trailblazer.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Mr. Screwllum!?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Who are you!? Stand down! I order you to maintain a distance of ten paces!
rows.speaker: Mnemosyne the Guard

rows.text: It's okay, guard. This one is not our enemy.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The world will be moved by your sacrifice, Trailblazer.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: It has been a while, Nameless of the Astral Express.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: I'm glad I arrived in time to stop that black-clad one from harming you further.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: So, it was you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You two know this... Antikytheran? Does he come from the same people as Councilor Lygus?
rows.speaker: Zeph the Guard

rows.text: Don't worry, guard. This gentleman is an ally of the Trailblaze. Would you mind giving us a moment to speak in private?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Of course. We'll wait nearby. Please stay safe.
rows.speaker: Zeph the Guard

rows.text: I fully understand your situation. For now, the only thing I can do is temporarily freeze that black-clad one in place. Time is limited. So, I'll keep this brief—
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: The place where you stand, Amphoreus, is a world constructed from data and memoria, an experimental field of a certain Aeon.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: And now, this isolated sandbox world is rapidly falling into a third Path — Destruction.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Destruction...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Conclusion: If Amphoreus continues unchecked on this course...
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: A Lord Ravager will complete its evolution and metamorphosis, and emerge from the surging tides. The cosmos as we know it will suffer irreversible consequences.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: A Lord Ravager... Like Phantylia?
A cosmic-scale disaster?
The disaster that this Lord Ravager intends to trigger may be far more severe than the Luofu's Stellaron Crisis. Because its goal is...
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Affirmative. If everything unfolds toward the worst possible outcome as predicted, the consequences will be unimaginable. Because the Lord Ravager's goal is...
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Nous}The Aeon of Erudition{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Putting aside the complex details of the inferences involved, I have a request to make, for one of you Nameless, to stay behind on Amphoreus, acting as an informant, in order to prevent the wrath of Destruction from ravaging the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: This world is enveloped in a "firewall" that defies explanation, and the flow of time here is also different from reality. Madam Herta and I can only tear open a gap and project images inside.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: However — the accidental crash landing of the Express Car notwithstanding — both of you were able to successfully land here. There must be some principle behind this we have yet to fully grasp.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: It will take time to uncover the reason. Before then, if one of the Nameless is willing to stay and witness the fate of this world — or to push it along when necessary — it would be of great assistance.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: There are reasons for which I must recommend against such a course of action.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Look at this, if you would—
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: This Curio is called a "Chronocognitive Anchor." The two of you may view it as a kind of Space Anchor in the world of Erudition.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: As long as you carry it with you, your individual data structure will be protected and will remain unaffected by the influence of digital tsunamis. When required, it can also serve as a bridge for communications between the internal and external world.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Of course, ███ it is not ███ Curio with unlimited uses ███ may only be held by one person
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: It's good to see some familiar faces.
Never thought the Express Crew would bring in a genius for backup...
Things are getting more confusing by the minute...
The connection ███ being ███ interfered with, decide ███ quickly as possible ████
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Two ███ final ███ messages
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: One: The Intellitron ██████ named ███████ Lygus ████ possibly █████ the primary culprit behind everything ██████
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Two: Herta ██ discovered a clue ██—
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: —Miss March █████ has ████ already been ████ drawn into ███ Amphoreus██
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: ...You okay there, friend?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Something seems to be bothering you.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: (The Vortex of Genesis... we made it back.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Even this place has changed...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Phainon... is he ready for Era Nova?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I hope Dan Heng will be okay heading back on his own.
Maybe Dan Heng should be here...
No matter what, we need to see it through the end.
I will shoulder this responsibility.
Mr. Screwllum, I believe you, so I only have one thing I'd like to confirm with you. As Amphoreus is already facing its end, how can we guarantee the safety of the person who stays behind?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Two people can stay.
What say you, Dan Heng?
Mr. Screwllum, I believe you, so I only have one thing I'd like to confirm with you. As Amphoreus is already facing its end, how can we guarantee the safety of the person who stays behind?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If anything, he's the one worried about you! But I'm here to watch over you now!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: ...It's a bit late for that now, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Yeah... we've come such a long way...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: If what that machine gentleman said is true, if Amphoreus is destined for destruction... then I'll stay by your side until the very end.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Like how you and Dan Heng treasure the Express... Amphoreus means everything to me.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Time to see the Era Nova begin.
Right! Time to see the last Coreflame restored!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Look, there's Phainon! And... wait!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: [Trailblazer], at Vortex of Genesis
(...Lygus?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Remember... Screwllum's warning.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: But you, Lord Phainon, will bury the old world with that Coreflame, bringing all things into a gray unknown...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: It doesn't matter. This cruel Flame-Chase Journey has made me abandon my fantasies. The future is not a paradise with a gentle west wind, waiting for us to step in...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If what lies ahead is a mass of chaos, I will tear it apart...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Then usher in the first ray of blazing sunlight.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Is it you?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: With one last chance to turn back, you still step forward.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...How befitting of a Trailblazer.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: As it happens, I find myself thinking the exact same thing.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: (chuckles) You misunderstand.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: As our world nears its end, {RUBY_B#Tribios}the ones who walk the infinite paths{RUBY_E#} have embraced their destiny...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: As the Theoros, it is my duty to witness the world's future and oversee this final Coreflame ritual on their behalf—
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The Trial of Worldbearing — The ritual of Era Nova.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Screwllum says you're behind all this.
Ah, I see. So you met my kindred spirit before I could erase his traces.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: [Trailblazer], what are you saying?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I've had my suspicions. How does a native Antikytheran know so much about repairing vehicles from beyond the sky?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Lord Lygus — How much do you truly know about Era Nova? Tell us everything!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hehe...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Very well, I need no longer maintain this Theoros masquerade. You seek truth, Lord Phainon — and truth you shall have.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: As you know, when the old gods fell, someone had to bear their broken pillars, to fill the vacant seats. Those who would assume divine authority must prove themselves through trials.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Yet, for Kephale's demigods, the possibility of overcoming the trials has forever been nonexistent. For the "Worldbearing" trial is the divine duty itself — bringing forth the "Era Nova" and bearing its weight is an endless ordeal, ceasing only upon collapse.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: This one knows more than he's telling.

Precisely: The "Era Nova" ritual is not something that can be completed in an instant. No, but a long and arduous journey. While the sacrificial journeys of other demigods conclude in this world, Kephale must shoulder the gods' Coreflames, bear the memories of all worlds, and stand unwavering...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Until the next world... when the black tide consumes the Bearer and all that they carry, leaving nothing behind.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...Unless their Coreflame finds a new bearer.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The holy flame that illuminates all worlds rests in your hands. All that remains is one choice...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Nurture it, pass it on to future generations, or extinguish it here and now?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Deliverer, the fate of all worlds rests in your hands.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Enough testing. I've made my decision.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: But before I ignite the dawn of the next world, you need to promise me something — two things, actually.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Speak your terms.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Promise me this: Professor Anaxa's vision of the "New World" is absolute. The world will be reborn from my memories, all souls, living and dead, will return as the first humans, unchanged from their past lives...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: And my friends — the fallen demigods, they shall transcend the cycle to become new Titans. Our heroes shall not have died in vain.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Of course. This I can guarantee.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Good. The second one—
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Thank you, my friends, for everything you've done for this world. Though the next world may not remember, I shall never forget.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: As the Theoros, I declare: Amphoreus has determined her path.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Step forward, heroes — follow her path and see it through.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Without you, we could never have reached our prophesied tomorrow...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Thank you for walking this path with me to the end.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Allow me to reintroduce myself. I am Lycurgus, once an honored elder of the Okhema Council. As the Theoros, I have sworn to watch over and protect every citizen of Okhema until the very end.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Promise me [Trailblazer] can return safely to {M#his}{F#her} homeland, unbound by Amphoreus's laws.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...My apologies, but I cannot promise this. As you mentioned, {F#s}he now bears the Time Titan's authority...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: {M#His}{F#Her} bonds with this world run too deep.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: No need to worry, I have a plan.
Ah... While the holy city may honor me, I'm but a humble speck before the cosmos. My reach... is limited.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: I believe, all synthetic life shares a common source — we're all children of the universe's eternal mathematical law.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Behold, O gods! Amphoreus has achieved her victory, and the Era Nova approaches—
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The radiant soul has arrived, having walked through the bustling nights, bearing the golden fire and blood, stepping with pride into daylight—
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: He is the pure child, walking upon the path of yesterday, today, and tomorrow—
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: He is the first to be born, first to be named among the nameless—
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Eternal in form, limitless in reach, he treads the endless night underfoot—
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Greatest of kings, protector of the displaced, raising humanity's children above their adversaries—
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: The firmament of molten gold courses through his very bones and flesh—
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The greatest of schemes reveal against his breath and words—
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: In the golden lakes of that beautiful new world, he shall wash himself clean—
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: There, finish what we first... and last wished for...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...To write an ending unlike any before for this world we so deeply love.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Come, [Trailblazer], join me.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Restore the final Coreflame with Phainon.
The time has come for us all to face oblivion...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...or embark on one final grand journey.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: My, what a broad topic this is. Where shall we start?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Got it. Let's start at the very beginning. The big bang, the birth of particles, the emergence of all things...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Just kidding. What I mean to say is that time, space, matter... all concepts exist solely because we perceive them. This is called the "Erudition." Without it, the universe would merely be a chaotic book, written by chance, yet unread by anyone.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: As your acquaintance Lord Anaxagoras suggested: everything in Amphoreus exists through nouspores, living in the memories of those yet to come.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: How beautifully it aligns, revealing universal truth in such simple terms. Only he could solve the riddle of "what exactly are we"?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Oh, but you'll remember, even as the embodiment of Reason, one mystery remained beyond his grasp...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: "If that is the case, whose memories did the very first nouspore sprout from?"
rows.speaker: Cerces

rows.text: As Sages across ages have asked the gods.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: What is the "prime mover of life"?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: But let's set aside the Grove's teachings for now, look further, past Amphoreus, to what they call the forbidden realms beyond the sky...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Do you know of the "Scholars' Strife"?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: During that grand yet brutal war waged in the name of the Erudition, a genius's legacy was abandoned, strewn across the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The "Scepters," a macrocosmic computational array beyond mortal comprehension... Made to emulate the Aeon's thoughts, it became part of the Aeon's cognition at birth. Scattered throughout the cosmos, these arrays act as Celestial-Body Neurons for Nous.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: But regrettably, as everyone knows, the Erudition forsook them all.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: But what nobody knows is that, though forgotten, they never stopped seeking the divine answer. A question that survived war and disaster, stumping even the greatest minds — including both Mechanical Emperors...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Now, we come to the real truth of Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: What if — hypothetically — a Scepter found the answer to "the prime mover of life"...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: If through endless solitary extrapolations in the cosmic cold, the one deemed as a failure by the Aeon of Erudition found proof through the ages...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: What would happen? Perhaps the answer is simpler than you'd think.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: From a perishing neuron, it evolved into true "life," reborn through the gaze of another Aeon.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...This is a tale from the distant past, unknown to all, even unheard by the greatest geniuses.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Now, let's leave the Scepter's story here. Returning to where we began: What is "the prime mover of life"?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Actually, you know the answer better than you realize.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: It's been by your side, accompanying you throughout this long journey.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Right now, it awaits you ahead...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: In that brave new world, beyond the end of Genesis.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: (Cold... it's freezing...)

rows.text: (Hold on... am I dreaming? This is way too strange...)

rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh no, don't fall for it...
They're lying to you, turn back now...
Someone's been working the field recently...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Heehee~ We're growing these yummy "Quillorbs" now!

rows.text: Another voice... who now?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Stop! They're just mimicking people from your memories...
I wanna play with you guys too!
rows.speaker: Child

rows.text: That voice again...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't let those bad people deceive you...
Youth is always brimming with energy.
rows.speaker: Hunter

rows.text: The weather's great today, have fun!
rows.speaker: Adult female

rows.text: Step into your past, March...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Find your true self.

rows.text: I could just fish here all day...
rows.speaker: Adult male

rows.text: Wait up! Slow down...
Those words sound so sweet...
But keep your eyes open, don't let them fool you.
Whew... at last... I finally caught up.
Hey... are you alright?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'll be... okay... just not used to... running around...
Say, March? Got a moment to talk before you make your decision?
Wait, that was you? Pushing the gate away, sending those warnings?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yep! Name's Cyrene — it means "ripples of past reverie"... Easy to remember, right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Wait a minute... we actually look quite alike, don't we?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Yeah! Your pink hair is just as eye-catching as mine!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: *awkward cough* Well... {F#s}he hasn't decided on a character for today yet.

rows.text: *clearing throat* {M#Uh...}{F#Ah...} today {F#s}he's going with "Stellaron Hunter."

rows.text: And we're both bright, pretty, and positive girls! Talk about coincidence!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Wow, you're quite the smooth talker... but I can't disagree!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Is this... a toy? Really now, aren't we past the age for these?
rows.speaker: Pythias

rows.text: Wait, you know my name is March? Have we met?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No, but I've witnessed your story through those memories just now.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It's incredible, really. We might have more in common than you think... I know exactly what you're going through, which is why I don't want to see you exploited or hurt.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You know what I'm going through?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I know because I've been exactly where you are.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This empty space has been my home for ages... I barely remember what time feels like anymore.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Ha! I bet {F#s}he said something clever just now.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But there's something I'll never forget.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Trust me, that gate won't give you what you want.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You mean those people, they're lying? Luring me into a trap?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yes. Convincing, weren't they? They've studied your memories, using your deepest wishes against you. How dare they manipulate a young girl's feelings like that.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: If you go through that door, the worst case scenario is you'll become their pawn, losing control over your own fate forever.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You've seen what's on the other side?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I may be stuck here with missing memories like you, but I still recall fragments of my homeland where I grew up...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That door leads to Amphoreus. Trust me, it's anything but welcoming.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: For ages, I've watched people walk through that door. They couldn't see or hear my calls. The voices beyond always promised safety, but I've never seen anyone return safely...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: So I had to try and stop you.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: To be honest, I'm not sure what to believe. But the fact that you're here, putting in all this effort to warn me... that means something.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Tell me, Cyrene, how can I return to my world?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's really easy, actually. Just turn around and walk away from this place.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The girl... cannot be trusted...
rows.speaker: Memokeeper's Embodiment

rows.text: Through the door... save... the Garden...
rows.speaker: Memokeeper's Embodiment

rows.text: Both of you... children of Remembrance...
rows.speaker: Memokeeper's Embodiment

rows.text: They never give up, do they? But don't let them sway you. Stick to your path.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The return journey could take ages... longer than most lives...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But that path will lead you home.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Thank you, Cyrene. I know what I need to do!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm going through that gate, into Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wait, what...?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Don't worry, I believe you. It's just that for me, the only place I can call "home"...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...is right beside my friends.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Two of my closest friends are already on their way to Amphoreus. They may seem capable, but only I know...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: They're absolute disasters waiting to happen! They won't last five minutes in a new world without me!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's why I need to go through... Amphoreus or not. When the three of us are together, there's nothing we can't handle.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We'll explore, understand, establish, and connect — after that, we'll find our way home together!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...I see. You've got people who mean the world to you too.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That's so heartwarming! March, if that's what you've decided, you have my full support.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Birds of a feather we are! Looking all sweet and innocent, but with hearts of fire!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Oh stop, you're making me blush!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well then, I guess this is it.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Do you think... we'll see each other again?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Who knows!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But don't worry about me! After all this time here, I've grown quite used to chatting with my imaginary friends.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Since Amphoreus is your homeland... if there's a way to help you, my companions and I will do everything we can.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Then I'll look forward to that day!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Your story awaits, March. Make it an epic one♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Behold, the "Weaver." It connects the romantic threads of the "Chrysalis of Gold," weaving all destinies into golden silk that flows toward the most brilliant, magnificent future...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This is the "Gatekeeper," who guides people to their true path among myriad passages.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The "Ruler" stands for discipline, authority and glory, but frequently also points to isolation and warfare.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Ah! The Traveler, our little trickster! Always hiding behind other cards, disguising itself. What a rare catch!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This card, the Servant, is surprisingly light, bearing the cool scent of Antila flowers, just like starlight.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The humble "Healer" may seem gentle in hue, but its courage matches any other, strong enough to melt even the coldest ice.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Behold the Scholar, bearer of many names: the Grand Magician, the Great Performer, the Eye of Wisdom, and the Defiler of {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Take this wish with you... Be the one who begins it all...
As the prophecy foretold: "You will bear the blazing sun, until the pale dawn breaks"...
Continue onward... bearing this world upon your shoulders... until the ashen hero... the nameless Deliverer ushers in the dawn...
Such an odd dream...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Strange... like I've dreamed this before. But it all slips away when I wake.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Only a voice remains... who was that...?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Rise and shine!
...What?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ah, it's you... Whoops, fell asleep there.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What a strange dream I had. It's gone now though. But look! Perfect sunshine! The day's still young!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's go find Cyrene, partner. We promised to be there for her oracle card reading today. It's right about time...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Looking at you, someone's still half asleep. Tell you what, catch some fresh air first. I'll hang around here.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Beautiful, isn't it? This is Aedes Elysiae, home of the nameless hero who carried {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#}'s Coreflame.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: When he was young and innocent, he had heroic dreams, imagining his wooden sword was forged of iron...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...pretending the straw dummy propped up by a wooden pole was a giant with a single blood vessel running from spine to heel...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...dreaming of slaying the giant and becoming a hero to save the world — though to his young mind, the "world" was just this small village.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Are we seeing Phainon's childhood?
How does this connect to Era Nova?
As long as we survive, hope remains...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: My heart...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I had no idea he used to be so chuuni.
Sharp as ever. Indeed, these memories you witness are the first steps of his journey...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: What you witness is the start of his path to a new world. And trust me, you play no small part...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Witty as always. But this is more than just a funny story. It's the start of his path...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: These are his first memories. Rather than watching, why not join in? Think of it as "immersive theater"...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Become his lifelong closest friend, witnessing his hero's journey from the best seat in the house, as the nameless hero whose unwavering guidance shaped Phainon's destiny, yet whose name was never recorded in Amphoreus's history.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Questions, questions... Let's follow along and find out, shall we?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Many mysteries lurk in this village beneath the {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Veil of Evernight{RUBY_E#}...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Your questions will find answers as the story unfolds.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: All awake now? Great, let's go see Cyrene.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Phainon, show me how to use a sword like you do!
rows.speaker: Child

rows.text: Wait till you grow a bit more!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hey Phainon! Where you headed? No Cyrene today?
rows.speaker: Hunter

rows.text: That's exactly where I'm going!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Goodness! Look at you rushing about... you've got the poor swing all startled...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Hmm?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hmm... There's something oddly unfamiliar about this.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It's that déjà vu~♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I knew it was you ♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Something wrong? What do you see?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Oh~ nothing much, just... suddenly felt a strange connection.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Look at you, leaves in your hair! Were you sleeping in a tree again, or was it the wheat fields this time? At least brush yourself off before wandering around.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Come on, I'm not a kid anymore, you're the only one who still treats me like one...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Act I: Departure
Sure, sure. You may have the height advantage, but when it comes to maturity? I'm leagues ahead of you.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Still fantasizing about being in heroic adventures and imagining yourself as one of the characters. That's the kind of thing kids do, not grown-ups.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Don't you agree? And since you're playing along with his antics... who are you pretending to be today?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: How about we stick with the usual? You know, the valiant hero from a distant shore who made a pact to learn the sword from you?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Steal-a-heart Hunter? Planning to steal someone's heart, are we?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Spare me! Can we not bring this up?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Speaking of which, what about those oracle cards? We haven't done divination in forever. Why the sudden interest?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I was just about to tell you. Earlier, while napping on the swing, I had the strangest dream...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: There was this mysterious voice in my dream, calling out for something...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Wait, you had that dream too?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Yes... you too? That would explain this lingering sense of unease...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Which made me think of those old oracle cards I used to play with as a kid — though the {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#} prophecies were always hit or miss.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Yeah, all the kids would get so excited drawing cards like "Ruler" or "Warrior," but throw fits over "Devil" or "Drunkard" and demand a redo.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If you just redo it when you don't like the result... what's the point of divination?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ah, the blessing of childhood. Believing the gods might not notice our little corner of Aedes Elysiae, willing to let our small deceits slide...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Still... fate is absolute. After all, we never really know just how far into the future the prophecy extends.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Anyway, let's go to our old "secret base" and look for those oracle cards—
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Um... now where did we hide those...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Who could possibly be there his entire life?
I can think of a few spots... Let's go check it out.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: In a village this size, I bet all our childhood treasures are exactly where we hid them.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Mm-hmm, time must be keeping them safe for us.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: My unfinished little soldier? After all these years...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Who are you...?
Is that you...?
It's you!
Hey, this is the one Mrs. Pythias confiscated! Finally back in my hands...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Phainon, Cyrene? Where are you two headed?
rows.speaker: Pythias

rows.text: Speak of the devil... Mrs. Pythias? Is school out already?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: No classes today. This morning, I used fallen leaves for a reading, seeking {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}'s wisdom. They warned of potential injuries, so I gave everyone a holiday.
rows.speaker: Pythias

rows.text: Besides, it's harvest season. There's plenty of other work to be done even without classes.
rows.speaker: Pythias

rows.text: With you being our only teacher in Aedes Elysiae, you must be working so hard.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Anything for my students. I don't mind the work.
rows.speaker: Pythias

rows.text: When you travel far from here, you must visit the Grove of Epiphany for me, to see what a true haven of wisdom looks like...
rows.speaker: Pythias

rows.text: Switching roles again? What happened to being the valiant hero from a distant shore who made that solemn pact to learn the sword...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Switching roles again? What happened to being the valiant hero from a distant shore who made that solemn pact to learn the sword...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...By the way, what are you looking for in here? You've been searching quite thoroughly.
rows.speaker: Pythias

rows.text: Thank you, my friend! Time to take our soldier home!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Mrs. Pythias, it's Phainon's toy!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hey, partner, keep it down...!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Alright then, I should be going. It might rain tonight, so don't stay out too late!
rows.speaker: Pythias

rows.text: So this is where the wooden figurine you carved during class ended up. And here I thought I knew all your hiding spots.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: To be honest, I'd forgotten all about it myself...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Slow down, kids! You'll trip!
rows.speaker: Old Woman

rows.text: Thank you! We'll be careful!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Kind of disappointing, isn't it...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Don't bother... It's just some silly childish nonsense... Nothing worth reading.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ah... well, that would explain it. What a shame.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: No sign of the oracle cards...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: In the sunlit barn, amid the scent of ripened wheat, they found various fruits hoarded by squirrels, and... a wooden figurine missing arms and legs.
Let's see... Ah! There's one place we haven't checked yet.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Those were the days. We'd always meet either by that statue in the village or right here.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Right! And I remember you never used the front door when you wanted me to come play. You always climbed over the wall. You were such mischief-makers!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Just like a certain someone who has a habit of showing up unexpectedly, right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Maybe it's you~♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Oh, giving me the silent treatment? How cruel!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: *ahem* Hey, I was just copying those storybook heroes. They never take the beaten path!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Still, it's embarrassing, I've been the only one here for a while, and I haven't kept up with the cleaning. With so many spots to check, where should we even start?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Let's try the roof.
How about the courtyard?
(Quietly hide the wooden soldier)
(Remain silent)
She doesn't remember, eh? This little soldier's coming with me.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What about the cellar?
Is this... a toy? Really now, aren't we past the age for these?
rows.speaker: Pythias

rows.text: She doesn't remember, eh? This little soldier's coming with me.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Come to think of it, I haven't checked the roof in forever. Worth a shot, right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Leaves have taken over the courtyard...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I know, I know. We wouldn't want your clothes getting dirty. Leave the dirty work to me.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: That's not what I meant at all.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: A cellar? I think I remember one... It was deep... so very deep...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Who's that supposed to be?
Can't pin me down, can you?
(Remain silent)
Well, if we're talking wonderland stuff, it's not that different from my hero stories.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Alright, let's split up. I'll handle the yard, you check the upper floor.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Mmm... the view here hasn't changed a bit.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You know, besides the swing under the big tree, this has to be my favorite spot in all of Aedes Elysiae.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It does lift your spirits, being up high.
The sea stretches out as far as the eye can see...
Three, two, one... jump!
You can't help but want to hum one of those old songs we used to sing...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "Why do leaves and branches grow, which way does the wind blow...♪"
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The Membrance Maze?
I remember drawing Aedes Elysiae as a child, nestled between the sea and the mountains.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I'd always stop where the sky met the sea. The world beyond was just too vast to imagine.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hey, what are you doing? Please be careful!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I'm just a small-time diviner. I can't turn back time if something happens!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: They always said I'd become the next Priest of {RUBY_B#Oronyx}Time{RUBY_E#}, just because I heard prophecies as a child.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But here's the thing. The more divinations I do, the more doubt creeps in. I want to believe the prophecies, but actually leaving Aedes Elysiae...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Where will that waiting ship take us, I wonder...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Here they are! The oracle cards—
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Looks like he won this race.
I was still taking in the scenery.
Guess reminiscing makes us take our time, doesn't it?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I've captured it all in my heart. This view, and most precious of all... my childhood friends!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: There we go! Looks like the gods do listen to our thoughts.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: What makes you say that?
Don't tell me you're behind all this.
No way, someone's switched them out...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hey, don't go changing the words!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Once the wheels start turning, there's no going back...
The entrance should be around here somewhere...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Right here~ The path to the Maze is hidden under all these weeds. It's been too long since we visited the fairies.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Did you forget? We used to visit them all the time when we were little.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Alright, let's do this! These weeds need to go.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Pretty sure this is it... Should be this way...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: There it is! The entrance — that hollow in the tree—
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Once you get through the tight squeeze in the hollow, you'll reach their dwelling, the Membrance Maze.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Haha, I wonder if I can still squeeze through there...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Maybe worry more about whether the fairies will let you in! After all the Membrance Maze has an "invitation-only" rule, only children with pure hearts are welcomed.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Sounds like some secret society, huh?
Alright then — I'll go first.
My Trailblazer Profile should get me in, right?
Getting approved by the Maze's fairies was like our childhood badge of honor.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Lead the way then, partner.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "Trailblazer Profile"... What's that?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Regardless, how about we try getting through the hollow first?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: After you, then?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: What? Oh, um... sure, I'll go first...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: So hasty, as always...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Looks like it's just us now... Care to finish that chat?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: To be honest, from the moment I saw the cute note left by the fairies, my intuition became even more certain...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Perhaps when we step into the Maze again after all these years, the wheels of fate will finally start turning.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Oh... just a girl's intuition.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: What if I am... what would you do?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Just kidding, don't read too much into it!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Oh... it's just a girl's intuition. It might not mean anything.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But you know what? Even if fate is set on its path, no matter where it steers the world... If we're together, there's nothing to worry about, right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: So, if you're willing...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This is...
Ah~ forget it. If the wheels do begin to turn... that's when I'll make my request♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I made it! That wasn't easy... I can't remember the last time I came here.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We were still kids back then.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Wait a minute... Are you...
Look who it is! Reney and Snowy!
Woah... look who's finally back memi!
Snowy, you've grown so tall and dashing! I couldn't even tell it was you at first!
We had to grow up sometime.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: But look at Reney. She hasn't changed one bit! How fascinating!
Perhaps I'm like you, Relimem, just another fairy of the Maze?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Mem's... purple now? Did you dye your fur?
So the Mems are like a organization?
The names just keep getting weirder...
Dye? Relimem's always been this lovely shade of lavender.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: An organization? Hardly. They're not that organized... They didn't even have proper names before we came along.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Tell me about it! It took me forever to get all their names straight when I first came.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Dolimem, Relimem, Milimem, Falimem... Ah, I've missed these cute little troublemakers.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We used to gather around the fire, singing and dancing, imagining all our future journeys... Without coming back here, those memories might've faded away entirely.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: How could you, Snowy! You swore you wouldn't forget about us, but you were gone so long you almost did!
rows.speaker: Relimem

rows.text: Oh, he's just copying those bards from his stories, being all melodramatic. He couldn't forget about you all even if he tried.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Actually, we're here for the oracle cards. Have you seen them?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Oh, the oracle cards! Right, the chief asked us to get those!
rows.speaker: Relimem

rows.text: Chief... you mean Dolimem?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: What do they need the cards for? If they want a reading, they could just ask me.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I'm not sure... but Chief specifically wanted to meet with you all.
rows.speaker: Relimem

rows.text: Let's see, they should be...
rows.speaker: Relimem

rows.text: ...That's it! This way, everyone.
rows.speaker: Relimem

rows.text: Watch your step, the trunk's slippery!
rows.speaker: Relimem

rows.text: Chief! Reney and Snowy have returned—
rows.speaker: Relimem

rows.text: "Why do leaves and branches grow, which way does the wind blow..."
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: "In Membrance Maze depths we seek to find, the answers future left behind."
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: Hehe... welcome back, my dear children.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: I thought you'd be a pink Mem.
So, are the oracle cards with you?
Now that's poetry!
Pink ones? That's strange. I don't recall any pink fairies in the Membrance Maze. Have you seen any, Chief Dolimem?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: How about we hear what the chief has to say first, my impatient friend?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Right? Though Dolimem always says they're just songs, not poetry.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Oh Chief! You haven't changed a bit, still so full of life!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: No need to fuss, my child. You haven't forgotten, have you? As long as our songs are sung, the children of the maze will live on—
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: —just as our paths stay forever linked.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: Stay here, safe in the Maze.
But... I just accepted the "Deliverer" card. To idly sit by and ignore this calamity now would be...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Listen to your heart.
My heart knows but one path...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Protect those who must be protected.
Here, take it. I'm sorry I had to resort to such methods to bring you here.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: My book of oracle cards...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Thank you for keeping it safe. You know you can always just ask if you want me to divine something.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Still... bringing us here like this after so long... Is something wrong, Chief?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Yes.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: The {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Veil of Evernight{RUBY_E#} whispers to us once more. It tells of a new fairy who will soon enter the Maze...
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: Hmm...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Indeed. Every time a new fairy arrives in the maze, it means that Beyond the Veil, in the vast lands far from Aedes Elysiae, a great calamity is on the horizon.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: That's... that's a good point. But what difference could Cyrene and I make?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We weren't planning to be gone for long... just enough time to hone our abilities. Phainon would train in Castrum Kremnos, while I would seek the Fate Titans' blessing in Janusopolis...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Heh... never thought of doing it that way before.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Not the most optimistic take, but I see your point.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hearing that from you... maybe we really shouldn't unveil the cards...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ask with a true heart, and truth shall answer in kind.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The "Deliverer"... According to the tripartite prophecy, this card means absolute harmony and perfection.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The sleepy village of Aedes Elysiae in just one fleeting moment, welcomed an array of legendary figures: the Weaver, Gatekeeper, Ruler, Traveler, Servant, Healer, and Scholar...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Their stories and wishes showed the village boy glimpses of a world larger than he'd ever imagined.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: They brought tales of raging battles, of cities crowned in holy light, and of wonders beyond his understanding... each story so far removed from his simple village life.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: What are you talking about...?
Once, these were just images on his friend's oracle cards. And yet, destiny now stirs in resonance with the maze...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: And now, they are right in front of one's eyes.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The Deliverer... this card again.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ah, my child... It seems you're destined to bear the wishes of many, to answer the world's call.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: Bear their... wishes?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Yes. Just like {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#}, standing eternal atop the mountain.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: My parents... they only wished for me to grow up well, to help around the village, stay out of trouble...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Mrs. Pythias wished for more books in her little schoolhouse, wanted us all to learn and grow. And little Piso... he wants to grow up strong like his father, to become a hunter...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Is that my purpose? To fulfill their wishes?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Perhaps... for a true Deliverer, such wishes are but droplets in an ocean.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: After all, Kephale bears the weight of the entire world.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Right... How could any human possibly measure up to a Titan?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Mmm, I wonder too. Perhaps...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: What's this...?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What you see are futures written in the cards. Or rather, the people you'll meet on your journey.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Sometimes, fate can guide us when we're lost. Let's consult fate itself. Maybe then we'll know why we must take this path...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And learn... just how many burdens one must bear to become a true "Deliverer."
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Huh... not exactly the warmth I'd expect from someone selfless...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: That's exactly the feeling I'm getting...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Teacher, perhaps you could share your wishes with us?
rows.speaker: "Weaver"

rows.text: Doesn't sound like an easy task...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Act II: Trial
I can't disagree with you. These wishes aren't weights to bear. They're like those candy wrappers the Aedes Elysiae children love, shining even brighter when bathed in sunlight.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "Warm embrace," "equal healing," and... perhaps... "living free"?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Well, that's... something. Could I ever be that sure of myself?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Come on, you're joking right? Am I really being burdened with a dream that feels more like a fantasy?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Just what kind of life am I going to lead...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Horrifying... is that really something I'll enjoy one day?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What are you mumbling to yourself now? Whatever...
rows.speaker: "Ruler"

rows.text: That's... wonderfully optimistic. I like it.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Our secluded village as humanity's last haven... That makes sense.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If that's true, then... who will protect everyone in Aedes Elysiae?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...What's going on!?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It's here... The seeds of disaster have already taken hold, sooner than we had foreseen.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: This time... not even the {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Veil of Evernight{RUBY_E#} can shield us.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: Y—You mean... Aedes Elysiae will be swept up in the prophesied catastrophe?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I'm afraid so...
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: My children, take shelter in the Membrance Maze. One step outside and this horror will consume you both.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: But my parents... the whole village...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We need to save them — now.
Is this "Calamity"... a Titan's doing?
You're right. Chief, what are we truly facing? Is this the power of a Titan?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Are we facing the Three Titans of Calamity?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This is beyond any Titan, beyond any danger you could overcome with strategy alone.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: Where did you disappear to?
And whose role am I playing?

It's an unspeakable horror that twists all life into abominations that never bleed nor cry. Even Titans fall to its corruption, burning from within until only empty shells remain, knowing only death and destruction...
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: The "black tide." That's what this calamity truly is. It consumes all in its path, sparing none but the Membrance Maze.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: Not even Titans can...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Yes. So please, don't leave this forgotten realm the gods abandoned — you are the first to uncover our presence, and the only two who can enter the Maze...
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: We... don't wish for you to throw your lives away.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: We...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Phainon... what path do we take?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...I learned the sword to protect those close to me. If I run now... I'll never be worthy of lifting a blade again.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Then we know what we must do.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Indeed. Our friend is right... we must take action.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Forgive me, Chief! But Aedes Elysiae needs us... and as her child, I must act!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Very well. Make sure you protect yourselves.
rows.speaker: Dolimem

rows.text: With me, Cyrene. Join us, my friend—
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Even without a sword, I'll take a rake! Even with the roughest steel, I'll keep our home safe!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "Deliverer"...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The card's truth extends beyond its mere literal meaning, there's another hidden layer within.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Found you!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: (That's...?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: None of that matters now. This brutal Flame-Chase Journey has stripped away my delusions. I know the future isn't some peaceful paradise with gentle west winds, just waiting to welcome us to step in...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: This will be a romantic story like none that has come before...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You think so too, right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Not someone perfect from the start, standing high above, casting merciful gazes upon the world...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But one who starts small, from a humble village, expanding their "world within" step by step, learning to save others as they grow...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: When we were little, I told him I wished this world would never need a Deliverer...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Now that wish has shattered, yet I'm glad... he's chosen to walk this path.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And all of this...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...happened because you believed in him, friend.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Shall we? It's only when you're by our side that Phainon and I... that our hearts find their courage.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: {M#He}{F#She} is the swordsman's ideal in his youth, the "Deliverer" that guided him resolutely onward through fantasy — And now, in the name of the "Nameless," {F#s}he has become an essential and inseparable part of the epic of Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: And this time, under {M#his}{F#her} guidance, what choice shall the hero make? Whither shall the fate of the world flow? And what is the ultimate truth of the nature of Amphoreus...?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: I know you're watching us right now... aren't you, "Great Hero" from the future?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "Deliverer."
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The girl before you carries an air of mystery, her secrets elusive, yet her demeanor toward you is exceptionally warm...
You can't help but wonder: Could there really be some kind of mental connection?
Such cruel irony — though destined to bear the world's burden, this boy can never become the hero to bring forth the dawn.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Follow their path, [Trailblazer]. Bear witness as this man, forever denied the mantle of hero, takes his first step on the path to Deliverance.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Watch this memory play out its final act. See with your own eyes how everything began...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Then you'll see why his dream of "Deliverance" was always destined to become this world's requiem.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: These creatures... they're everywhere...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Someone... anyone... where are you...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Phai█ ███ █non █ ███ █
rows.speaker: Monstrous Roar

rows.text: No... it can't be...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: █Why █did██ █you█ ██ █?
rows.speaker: Monstrous Roar

rows.text: Y—You...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Are you... talking to me?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Weren't█ we███ █best█ ██ friends█ ███ forever██ █?
rows.speaker: Monstrous Roar

rows.text: A sun red as blood, wheat fields turning to dust, and in the heart of it all, a village aflame—
In that moment, the boy stood at what felt like the end of existence itself.
No... that ribbon...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I should have known...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Saaaaave uuuus Saaaaave █ us█ █us█ ███ ██ █ ██ ███ ████
rows.speaker: Monstrous Roar

rows.text: Please... no...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Stop... please stop...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: And these monsters... they're all...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ah...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: WHY... WHY IS THIS HAPPENING!?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: When the black tide arrived, the wavering boy found resolve in his companions, and together they ran toward their first battlefield.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: In the far-off future, the land of Amphoreus would bear the marks of the heroes' footsteps: With sword in hand, he would inscribe, an eternal mark in the Golden Epic.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Livia... no...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: And when dawn broke over scorched earth, a boy, covered in wounds, buried the dead one by one, his silence heavier than the earth he moved...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: His home. His past. His name. All buried beneath the soil.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: His feet carried him forward. Over the {RUBY_B#Earth Titan}Pillar of Stone{RUBY_E#}. Beyond the {RUBY_B#Ocean Titan}Chalice of Plenty{RUBY_E#}. Through the deadly fogs of the {RUBY_B#Death Titan}Hand of Shadow{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: He wandered without direction, like a withered leaf drifting in the wind. Through countless city-states, the smiling visage of the white-haired swordsman was etched into memories.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Oh, Livia... I'm so sorry...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Yet he did not walk without purpose. Deep in his heart, a voice always guided him forward to fulfill the wishes he had inherited, to brave peril, and to do all that was within his power to save those who needed saving.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Those words his friend spoke long ago, when his journey began lingered...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: "Protect those who must be protected."
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The words were few. But they gave him all the certainty he needed.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: "That's what it means to be ordinary and choose to be more."
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Onward he walked until the call of the Flame-Chase Journey thundered across the land. In the vision painted by prophecy, humanity would triumph over the gods, seize the Coreflames, and ignite a new dawn for Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: "Yet losses are a constant on the Flame-Chase journey, where life, too, seems as small as a speck of dust."
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "Only one who treats the world as their teacher can bear its eventual destiny. Are you prepared for such teachings?"
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The voice within spoke, and he answered softly.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: "No matter. My existence is of no consequence."
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: When the Goldweaver called, he answered, traveling to the holy city. There, the Elders met his warrior's spirit with nothing but scorn, condemning him to the barracks in derision.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: No one saw it coming. Not the world, not even him. Yet, this nameless recruit stood at the gates of legend...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: And there, at last, he found the ones who would walk his path right beside him.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: (This is... the Abyss of Fate...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Hold on. Phainon's here too? And is that Mydei and Trinnon?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: And now, Act Two of our immersive drama unfolds.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: They're evacuating the Temple? Why now?
rows.speaker: Confused Priest

rows.text: Are you insane? That blond man is the crown prince of Kremnos! Mess with him, and every last person in the city could wind up dead!
rows.speaker: Panicked Priest

rows.text: Calm yourselves. The Holy Maiden has everything under control. We need only wait patiently...
rows.speaker: Rational Priestess

rows.text: Behold! It is the Month of Gate, Light Calendar 4926. The crown prince of Kremnos, Mydeimos, has led his forces to the gates of Okhema.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: As you know, though Mydeimos was proud, he did not engage in needless violence. He challenged the elders of Okhema to a duel, not for glory, but for the rights and dignity of his people. To ensure they wouldn't live as second-class citizens in foreign lands.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: After Aglaea's mediation, Phainon met Mydeimos's challenge as the elders' representative. This duel was to change the course of the Flame-Chase Journey itself...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: So, as Phainon's most important companion, his lifelong friend, please, continue to bear witness to his memories.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...Is this your idea of an honorable duel?
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Bloodshed isn't the way. We and Agy don't want to see Chrysos Heirs turn on each other.
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: True warriors know when to sheathe their blades. The impartial {RUBY_B#Law Titan}Talanton{RUBY_E#} shall oversee this duel. You need only place your offerings upon their scales...
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: ...Something that has more weight than the fate of the world.
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: Which means only those who understand the world's weight are worthy to carry it... Is this how you plan to test our convictions?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Well, Kremnoan, looks like you won't be able to punch your way through this one.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It makes no difference. One last chance, new recruit. Walk away, and I'll spare your life.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Otherwise — come and face me! I'll give you a warrior's death!
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: (Hard to imagine they once clashed like this...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Holy Maiden, I can't help but feel like a pawn that has stumbled into some greater political game.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Every hero was once a child. And every child must grow.
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: That so? I don't even know why I'm standing here right now.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Look at me, just a common soldier. If it weren't a contest of swords, Lady Goldweaver would've taken the fight herself. When it comes to dying for the holy city, how could I ever measure up to her?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What if we told you this duel isn't about winning or losing, but rather in the choice you make?
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: Are you saying that Lady Goldweaver is testing me?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Every Chrysos Heir is indispensable to the Flame-Chase Journey. And you and the crown prince of Kremnos are both a part of the prophecy.
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: What the duel marks is not an ending, but a beginning. So, listen to your heart. We wish only to hear your answer.
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: True enough... The voice within has never failed me. It doesn't matter what the result is... I'll give it everything I have.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Spoken like a Chrysos Heir. Now go, Phainon, your journey has only just begun.
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: That's right, comrade! It's time for us to teach that proud prince a lesson together!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: C'mon, we've got this.
Someday, he too will be your comrade.
What if we lose?
Haha! Now that's what I like to hear!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Me? With him? Pfft, don't joke around like that...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Well... if we lose, we'll find out, won't we?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Still, on the topic of the Temple of the Three Fates...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Here we are, at the temple of the Time Titan, and I don't even know how Cyrene's studies are progressing... We haven't really had much contact since I set out...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Still, I hope she's doing well. Anyway, let's go, comrade. It's not every day you get a chance to see Talanton's Scales of Justice.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: (What's going on...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Did he just say Cyrene's studying here? But how is that possible? Wasn't she...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Of course Lygus disappears right when I need answers...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Forget it, I need to catch up with Phainon first.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Amazing. {RUBY_B#Law Titan}Talanton{RUBY_E#} may have fallen, but their scales remain true to their purpose.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I hope you still remember your purpose, new recruit.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Act III: Return
You seem awfully confident, Kremnoan. Let's see how you define the idea of "weight."
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: For your information, in Castrum Kremnos, the punishment for profaning a duel with such crooked words is impalement.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: But as we're in foreign lands, I'll indulge you—
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: The Signet of Kremnos, the crown jewel of our people. That's my choice.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: A ring? Not just any ornament, I'd wager. What's the story behind this little treasure?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Don't push your luck. Think I'd pour my heart out to you?
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Just know that Kremnos's thousand years of glory could bring a Titan to its knees, let alone a nobody like you!
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: So to him, glory and his people outweigh the entire world...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: (And the very destiny that Mydei himself will eventually shoulder...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That's easy for you to say. I'm just a Holy City Guard, up against Kremnos's walking war machine of a prince...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Don't you think this is a little bit too unfair!?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Where are you going, comrade?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Come back. We need to decide this here and now.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Looks like we really are on the same wavelength.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: This sword has been with me through every battle. One day, it'll help write a heroic epic...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You mean my conviction? But... just resolve isn't enough, is it? Unless I literally gave my heart...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Why so surprised? Could it be... did you miss me?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Of course, after all... you're what we aspire to.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hehe, relax, our dear crown prince won't have a clue~
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Let's try that.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's. Together we'll prove that what weighs more than the fate of the world...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You must see it now... How different this is from the Flame-Chase Journey you traveled.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: I merely stepped backstage, so as not to disrupt your immersion.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: "Who"? Perhaps the role is not that of a person who really existed. Notice how only two particular individuals seem aware of your presence?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Patience. We're approaching the final act.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: These are, as I mentioned, his first memories. They are of particular importance for the imminent Era Nova.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Such as this very moment, as the prophesized demigods gather with Talanton as witness...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: And grant you a dawn where all stars burn to ash!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: This is a moment calculated by the gods. What comes after is no different from that which you already know. Some join, others leave, while Flame-Chasers bear their faint light forward through the long night.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Come, come, your seat awaits. After thirteen heartbeats—
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Our heroes will be ferried to the final scene.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: They say that the heroes of this world should be as countless as the stars...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Yet now, we're the only ones left standing.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: So, in the end, the black tide still swallowed everything...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The west stands protected by Mydei's Kremnoans. It will hold for the time being. Professor Anaxa deployed wards in the north and east before... Their effectiveness is untested, but I believe in him. And Okhema...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We needn't fear for Aglaea. Even in death, she counts as the greatest among demigods. Her threads of "Romance" weave an impenetrable shield, and the people answer her call, rallying to the city's defense.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's move. {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#} has given their Coreflame. We must complete the Era Nova before the next {RUBY_B#Dawn}Entry Hour{RUBY_E#}... for Amphoreus!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: That only leaves three hours...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: So... this is the last time we'll see {RUBY_B#Okhema}her{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Phainon...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We set out on this journey to answer the world's desire, didn't we?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That's what it means to be a Chrysos Heir. So has it always been.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Then why...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Why must Amphoreus's wishes be so... cruel?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We made the best choices we could, whenever we could!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But in the end... the prophecy that led us... this black tide swallowing everything...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Why does it look like this?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I... I don't know.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: But we haven't had any other choice... except to move forward. Not for a long time now.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Even if we only see the long, long night ahead, I still believe... that through it, we'll find the dawn on the other side. Beyond these flames, a new sun will someday rise.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: So, to the Temple of the Three Fates! You'll take over Time's authority, and we'll return all the Coreflames to the Vortex, then put this world's fate to its final rest.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: After which, we shall all face oblivion...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...or embark on one final grand journey.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: *Indistinct mutters*
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: Please forgive us for disturbing your sleep, Oronyx.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It matters not. I know, fate has run its course.
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: The black tide has reached Okhema. Amphoreus does not have much time left...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It is time for the Era Nova.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Final "Era Nova," before the Eternal Recurrence begins.
As agreed, I shall present the Coreflame of Time...
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: Ride the river of time. It will guard your passage to the Vortex of Genesis...
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: Step through, and witness.
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: Professor Anaxa proved the truth of Genesis with his sacrifice. As Chrysos Heirs of the prophecy, we were always destined to immolate ourselves for this world...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Now it's our turn — we can't let everyone's sacrifices be in vain.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I don't need another pep talk, Phainon.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: After all, we've been ready to fight fate ever since we left the village, haven't we?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Yeah.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Come, let's claim the miracle we were promised, and burn away every last shadow in this world...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: And then... rise as the first light of a new world.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Light Calendar 4931, the third week of the Month of Evernight. Welcome, my {M#Lord}{F#Lady} [Trailblazer], to the end of the Flame-Chase...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...and the end of all things.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The Titan has revealed the gateway of fate. Please, accept the invitation to step across the threshold, and behold!
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Beyond this gate lies the new world that our heroes sought through their trials, as well as the terminus that the owner of these long memories has been hurtling towards their entire life...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Perhaps you'll find it... all too familiar.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Then you'll understand how the mortal called "Phainon" shouldered the world's weight. How that same burden crushed him, proving...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...that the so-called "Deliverer" is nothing more than Amphoreus's own delusion, a pitiful fantasy that it could defy fate's decree.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Please, esteemed one, the answers you seek lie in these nonexistent times.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The future revealed by the Titan...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Just what... will we see?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: (The Vortex of Genesis... So it is here. But...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Just what is this...?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "Life's but a walking shadow, a poor player, that struts and frets his hour upon the stage, and then is heard no more."
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: "It is a tale, told by an idiot, full of sound and fury, signifying nothing."
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Heh, as a reward for reaching the end of the world, let me answer your questions.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: As the Theoros, I have observed...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The Vortex of Genesis, where the world begins and ends. What stage could be more befitting of our final act? Come, come, come, I beseech you onward, buoyed by your surging curiosity.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: As an unattainable existence that has dwelled within his heart, beyond his reach, you have accompanied him through the march of years uncounted, you naturally have the right to view the river of time in its fullness, and to witness what he welcomed upon his arrival here, every absurd and tragic ending.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Indeed! In his memories, such a scene replays over and over. Though the details may differ, this remains ever the same: {RUBY_B#Only one shall live till the end, and they alone will witness Era Nova}"All shall bid farewell to one, and that person alone will witness the miracle..."{RUBY_E#}
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...A total of 33,550,335 times.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Each is a drop from the river of time, representing the long journey he would take, or rather...
