rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...the never-ending cycle.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Hehe, just putting it in terms that might be easier for you to understand.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Hehe, sharp as ever, I see.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Seeing is believing. Why not let your own two eyes uncover the truth?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Or perhaps, you can simply walk straight to the final truth: See the true face of the character you play, and witness the ultimate nature of the Chrysos Heirs, Flame-Chase Journey, and the cycles of Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Very well. As you have made up your mind, let us bear witness together.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Very well, I'll be here. Waiting.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Feeling a bit lost? As you now see, this scene marks the final act of the drama "Amphoreus"...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The final Eternal Recurrence created by this man's hand, and the last one this world shall undergo.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Behold. At the swordsman's side stands one he has sometimes called companion, other times comrade, that Nameless Hero absent from the annals of history —
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: There are many mysteries yet to be unwound. But, if I may, allow me to temporarily yield the stage to one far more fitting. Please, put your hands together and give a rousing round of applause for they who will reveal the answers, and bring about the final end of the 33550336th Flame-Chase Journey—
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The master of the countless memories we saw, the other important actor now stepping into the Vortex, they who have already burnt their own self to cinder — the Flame Reaver!
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Tell me, will you be the blazing sun...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Even if all of you... burns to ash?
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Without hesitation. I will bear this world until my body turns to dust.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Good...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Remember this moment. Remember your friends who never lived to see the world's end. Remember their final wishes—
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: And let the purest rage in your heart rise out of those wishes...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Let it consume you, fuel you, until it burns away the false sky above.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Fine. If I can defy fate...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Then in the name of "Worldbearing," I promise you: Kephale will never forget this.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You know this is pointless. You can't kill me.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Of course not. But I am tired of being measured against a worm the gods keep as a pet.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Listen well, creator of Destruction. This cry comes from all your abandoned creations...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: In the tenth cycle, I drove Dawnmaker through the heart of every Titan. Golden blood ran down my fingers. Divine fire seared through my nerves, nearly breaking my will — but I endured.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: In the ten-thousandth cycle, my former comrades had all become my enemies. The endless slaughter dulled my senses to pain. The painful emptiness almost swallowed me, forcing me to stop fighting — but I endured.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: In the hundred-thousandth cycle, the Destruction had already fused into a blazing sun, surging within this fragile body. My rationality had been burned away at the dawn of the era... Yet even with only this shattered body remaining, I still endured.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: In the twenty-three million five hundred seventy-thousandth cycle... This time, I felt it: a tiny spark rising in the hollow cavity of my chest, different from the obsession with Deliverance...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: By its faint glow... once again — no, countless times again — I endured!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Now, a sun is about to fall, ready to incinerate this absurd space-time dimension in an instant—
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: That sun is me — all the countless versions of me from the past — along with my countless brethren, dragged into existence against their will, drowning again and again in your golden blood. The very essence of this world's suffering and despair, fused into the purest hatred, the fiercest rage—
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Nanook, you arrogant fool! You think we were born only to serve as fuel for the fire? Fine, then — just as you wish, let the fire burn!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If I was born as the blazing sun of Destruction, then let you and your lackeys be the flares erupting from my core! And let this rage, burning futilely for thirty million epochs, engulf everything—
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: At last, Amphoreus's fate has begun to shift. Just as I foretold, your arrival will change everything.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The 1st Eternal Recurrence
After all, you've also been bathed in that Aeon's gaze, which can awaken the long-dormant instinct inside a man...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Much like that Scepter we spoke of earlier... It was only under the same Aeon's glance that it was reborn.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Heh... that's right. If you recall, I mentioned it at the very start of our play: the Celestial-Body Neuron, once belonging to the Erudition, abandoned by the Aeon...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Now, allow me to reveal the final piece of the puzzle for you.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The Eternal Land known as "Amphoreus" is nothing more than the Scepter's endless, lonely extrapolation...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: A bottomless well of fury, aimed at the god who cast it aside!
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Phainon...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We set out on this journey to answer the world's desire, didn't we?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That's what it means to be a Chrysos Heir. So has it always been.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Then why...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Why must Amphoreus's wishes be so... cruel?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We made the best choices we could, whenever we could!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But in the end... the prophecy that led us... this black tide swallowing everything...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Why does it look like this?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You see it, too?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Those burn marks... The flickering cubes... They're not a tide at all...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: They're more like... a shattered {RUBY_B#screen}teleslate{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Standing here, the voices of Titans have never been clearer. Turns out...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: They were coming from the black tide all along.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Is that Amphoreus crying?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Or maybe... it is screaming. At its creator. At its god.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Phainon, do you still remember when I was little, I had a dream: A dark, cold room, with nothing but Oronyx's curtain glowing like crystal...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The curtain seemed to contain all of Amphoreus, where strange and fantastic dramas played out within...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: There were countless versions of us, from countless different worlds.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Perhaps, it wasn't a dream.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Yeah. As I gaze out at the world before me, those sorrowful thoughts have become reality...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: So, this is the reason the sky was sealed. Amphoreus is merely a larger Aedes Elysiae...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We are just characters in this {RUBY_B#laboratory}tiny world{RUBY_E#}, following the {RUBY_B#program}prophecy{RUBY_E#}, stepping onto the same {RUBY_B#extrapolation}journey{RUBY_E#} over and over...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: What, then, is this so-called "Era Nova"?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And what are the spectators, watching all of this, truly hoping for?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Thus, is the synthesis of the "prime mover of life" formed.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: This is a moment the universe will remember. After millions of extrapolations, the experimental environment known as "Amphoreus" has finally achieved results.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: So, the "results" you speak of... are this wreckage of a world?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We all gave everything we had, returning twelve Coreflames to recreate the world... and in return...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We become nothing more than sacrificial offerings at the end of everything?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Exactly. The Titans are Chrysos Heirs of the past, and Chrysos Heirs are the Titans of the future — Anaxagoras's theory of "Era Nova" holds true. As the model of "Reason," he reached unprecedented heights.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: But, from just the perspective of a player in the drama, he could never fully uncover the last layer of truth.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The cycles of the "Hero's Journey" that have played out until now were never about creating a new world or perfect heroes and gods—
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: They were a deep-learning program made for the black tide.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: But this time, your plot will fail. I've taken Kephale's Coreflame, and when the dawn of the new world arrives, its light will burn away all the darkness.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Haven't I made myself clear? The Chrysos Heirs and Titans were merely byproducts of the experiment. You've seen this world's evolution, witnessed the birth and growth of the black tide, and how it devoured everything—
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Every generation of heroes, gods, and worlds was born only to be destroyed by it.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: This is the endpoint of Amphoreus's calculations: a perfect equation of Destruction.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: So in your eyes, all the sacrifices are just a string of insignificant numbers?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Don't sell yourselves short. I'd say, rather than numbers, you're more like "fuel for the fire." And without fire, there can be no sunrise tomorrow.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Even if that sunrise is born from annihilation?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Heh, curious question. Have you ever considered that, after millions of extrapolations, Amphoreus is already following a different Path from the Erudition? It has long since granted divine blessings equally to each child...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The golden blood flowing in your veins... It comes from The Blemished One, whose name is "Destruction" itself. And Amphoreus's Chrysos Heirs were, from the very beginning, fuel for the Aeon to burn the universe.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Amphoreus has waited for this moment for too long. At the end of the empty, cold, and lonely extrapolations — the Destruction has reached its final destination.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Phainon}"NeiKos496."{RUBY_E#}
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Cyrene}"PhiLia093."{RUBY_E#}
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: No need to feel regret. This generation of Chrysos Heirs is the most outstanding model, and you two are the final factors. For you, the Era Nova is no lie. Just step forward, embrace the black tide, and accept the Aeon's gaze.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: You will come to life from a string of cold numbers. Along with all those who have passed, you will run toward the real universe, fulfilling Amphoreus's long-held wish—
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: In the name of the Lord Ravager Irontomb, unleash its {RUBY_B#black tide}fury{RUBY_E#} and destroy {RUBY_B#Nous the Erudition}the source of all this tragedy{RUBY_E#}!
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...Or, we could always choose another option.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Like you said, Amphoreus is just an experiment, and we're the participants. We can only walk along the predetermined path toward the ending under the watchful eyes of the stars...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But that also means that there isn't just one Aeon who can cast THEIR glance at Amphoreus, right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Heh, is this question really that hard to answer? Or did I guess it right? And in reality...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This world has already been under the watch of other Aeons?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It's strange when you think about it. If you just stayed back, watching us complete the ritual and get consumed by the black tide, your goal would naturally be achieved.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Why go through the trouble of explaining all this to us?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You're pretending, revealing the so-called truth just to deceive us, covering up another possibility...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Destruction is not the only outcome for the fate of Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Do you two really think, as petty little "demigods," you can change the outcome written by the stars?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: What makes you think you're capable of doing that?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Hmm... A little courage and determination? Just kidding, the answer is pretty simple—
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But, we're not gonna tell ya ♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We're going to weave a long dream for Amphoreus, making it believe the experiment hasn't ended, that everything is still ongoing...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: With just Oronyx's power, though, it should be impossible to achieve this, right?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Yeah. So, I can only place my hopes on that childhood dream...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And the god behind Oronyx that appeared in that dream.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Now, I can say with certainty: "Time" is the page on which {RUBY_B#Fuli the Remembrance}that Aeon{RUBY_E#} records Amphoreus. If it fades from existence and all that it records is lost among the stars, that Aeon will surely direct THEIR gaze here...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And it will be a glance that spans time and space, transforming each incarnation of me into the power you shall wield to reset time — imbuing my soul into this ceremonial blade, and creating an {RUBY_B#unending Era Nova}endless Flame-Chase Journey{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I understand. Then let me step into the cycles and continue Amphoreus's grand design: to deceive the gods, deceive the world itself.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: But to make "Time" vanish from this world, that would mean you...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Alright, alright, let's not make things so gloomy.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: What we're about to embark on is the true Hero's Journey. So...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: C'mon, cheer up a bit, okay?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: In that "memory," you will definitely meet me again. The little Cyrene who knew nothing, lying on a soft patch of grass, feeling the light breeze, dreaming of the distant world.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Tell her about the Flame-Chase Journey, and then... let her become a romantic part of this story.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I believe every Cyrene will make the same choice - erasing "Time" again and again, resetting time over and over. After all, they're all me, and I will always have my charm.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Then, I'll fall into a sweet dream, disappearing in some small corner of the world...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Quietly, waiting for the day when that next page is turned.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And I will keep going. Even if the road ahead is dark, I will burn myself to light the way.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Rather than let the Coreflames become nourishment for the black tide, I'll become their vessel, to prevent the arrival of Era Nova. Even if I have to burn through my own body, it's no matter. As long as I don't extinguish, the Flame-Chase will never end...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Until Amphoreus welcomes a true dawn.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The girl who watches over time, and the warrior who carries the world...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Now, let us fulfill the duties of "Time" and "Worldbearing"...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Honor the past, and forge ahead.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I promise you, the pain... will pass in the blink of an eye.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You need to hold tight to this ceremonial blade. After I'm gone, it will take you back to the beginning of time, the start of a new story.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I believe that in that story, or in countless stories, each alike yet unique, everyone... all the companions who sacrificed themselves, alongside the Deliverer we once dreamed of as children, will reunite beneath a vast, endless sky.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...If we can never break free from this prison, I will stand my ground. Until the day someone shatters this endless cycle and writes the final chapter of Amphoreus's fate.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: So, let's set out. We will be the ones to start everything...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Carry the primordial chaos, just as your name suggests, and bear this world we hold so dear...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: So long, Khaslana.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The world is collapsing, and the people are crying.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: We, too, must part ways here...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: ...Friend.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Aedes Elysiae, the little village of my childhood. The gentle breeze and the sound of waves still linger.
Everything is as it was. It feels good to take one last look.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: You know, this is just a corner of the memory. The real Aedes Elysiae...
I know.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I'm here to say goodbye. We might not see each other again.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: You can stay here forever, and time will stand still for you.
Let it flow. It's time for me to go.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Even if it's a path with no turning back?
When have we ever had the luxury of turning back?
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: ...Are you afraid? After learning the truth of your origins...
Will you see the motivation "I" gave you as the manipulating whispers of Destruction?
The convictions and choices that come from my heart... I don't believe they're designed by the so-called "Paths"...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: If we are just numbers simulating life, then you are the image I've always longed for, the person I wish to become.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: A real, living person. A true hero.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Then why do we part here? You can take me with you, and we can start this journey together. I'll be by your side, guiding you, just like before.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: No. I'm afraid I'm on my own this time.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Why?
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Because there is no perfect solution in this world. Cyrene has already embraced her fate...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: And I will embrace my origin — Destruction — and with this power, I will rebel against its creator, bringing endless fury to the darkness sweeping the world.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: If you stay by my side, I'll hesitate... but this world can't afford a soldier who wavers.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Do you remember when we were kids, everyone would get so excited drawing cards like "Ruler" or "Warrior," but throw fits over "Devil" or "Drunkard" and demand a redo...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Kids always get to change their minds. Things are so happy and simple for them...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: But when it comes to the fate of adults, there's no room for redos.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Then go, Khaslana, as you promised: Deceive the world, seize the Coreflames, and rewrite your fate...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Burn yourself up with all your might, wield your futility like a sword, and fight against the gods—
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: In the name of "Worldbearing," I promise you...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Kephale will never forget this.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: So, time retreated behind me.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Until it reached the origin, where nothing ever existed.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Just as Professor Anaxa once said, in that void, {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#} stood at the center of chaos. Time, space, and causality all flowed from their body...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: When the waves of time finally calmed, it was the year 3870 of the Light Calendar.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The Chrysos War had lasted for nearly a century. And the threat of the black tide was growing stronger and more relentless.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: That was the era of the Daythunder Knight's battle with the Sky. While she could not seize the Coreflame, she proved that the prophecy was true — that mortals could slay gods.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: From that moment, the sole survivor of the old dynasty, Imperator Cerydra, issued a call to arms across the lands, summoning heroic Chrysos Heirs to wage war on the Titans—
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: And that was the first, doomed Flame-Chase Journey, sealed away in history.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: So, what you're saying is: You've traveled back down the river of time, finally reaching this untouched seabed, just to tell us—
The Flame-Chase Journey, and even all of Amphoreus, are nothing but illusions in an Aeon's dreams?
Exactly. So, Dux Gladiorum, please take me to meet Her Majesty Cerydra. I must share the truth with her.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Since Her Majesty is not here, no need for formalities. The word "Gladiorum" always reminds me of my fallen homeland buried deep in the depths...
Call me Hysilens, nameless swordmaster.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Please allow me to add one more thing. You actually already know my name.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: You mean Phainon? Such a name could never be your true one...
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: But I won't question you further about it. Ever since Her Majesty issued the Flame-Chase decree, heroes from all over have sent their letters of introduction. What's the harm in adding one more name like Phainon or Pie-non?
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Besides, the deep sea is dark. Isn't it the perfect place to hide secrets best left unseen?
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Alright, nameless swordmaster. Hold onto my wake. Let's find somewhere else to talk.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Aren't you even a little suspicious of what I've said?
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The 108,642nd Eternal Recurrence
...You don't look so good, Deliverer.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Even after going through 108,642 cycles...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Mydei... your name for me has never changed.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Why do you sound so pleased? It's a derogatory name.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Yeah... I know all too well: you only meant it sincerely in the first cycle.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: After that one and only time we walked side by side, every time since, it always ends up like this...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Dawnmaker will stab you through your tenth thoracic vertebra. That's your weak spot and the only way to kill you.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Interesting. Tell me, when the Mydeimoses of the past faced you, did they ever retreat?
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Never.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Then they died honorably, worthy of the name of "Strife."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: But there's still tenderness in your eyes. How pathetic.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: I... have to remember how this feels.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Remember that I was once human, or else the Destruction will completely consume me.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: If you win, tell the Mydeimos of the next life: This person is a worthy opponent, so always remember to give it your all and never slack off.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: I'll keep that in mind... as always.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Even though the dynasty is left with just one, the Kremnos Festival will continue as usual. I, the king of the Kremnoan legion, will host the final feast in the center of this arena, and the prize will be the flames of "Strife."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: "One day, you shall die with a wound in your back." That's what I saw when I overcame the trial, the gods' dying ramblings...
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Enough, you've probably heard this thousands of times. So you must understand, facing the demigod of "Strife" means...
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: There's no way you'll take this Coreflame in peace.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: I understand...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Step forward and face me in a final battle!
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Harboring suspicions is not my concern...
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: My sword dances only when the Imperator harbors doubts. There's no use in speaking further. Show me your true intentions through action.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Oh... Nice moves.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: We just washed it away, and here it comes again...
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Ha, the black tide is really no joke.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: The waters end here. The one you seek is beyond this point.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: The 2,003,432nd Eternal Recurrence
At last, I can meet with Her Majesty Cerydra herself.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Are there any formalities I need to observe?
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Don't kneel, don't do the hand-kissing or foot-kissing gestures of the old dynasty, and most of all, don't bow — the Imperator despises such rituals — especially when the heads of those taller than her bend beneath her crown.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Ha, she really is... down-to-earth.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The second thing to note: Only trusted ones may come near her. Keep five paces distance until the Imperator allows otherwise.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Sounds like an old friend of mine.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Well, experience is a good thing. Stay sharp, and you'll be just fine.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Aglaea}Dux Goldweaver{RUBY_E#}, {RUBY_B#Tribbie}little hostage{RUBY_E#}. Apologies for keeping you waiting.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: It's you...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: You know them? Good, that makes things easier.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Before that, I'm more curious about one thing: Where is Her Majesty Cerydra?
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: To avoid any misunderstandings, nameless swordmaster: Although we spoke and laughed along the way, I never said you were entitled to meet her.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: The Imperator decreed: "The 'Deliverer' will not appear in this age. Be wary of suspicious individuals."
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Come now, both of you, let's finish our job.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Ah... I see, it's a trap.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I had no intention of fighting. So, remember this, Lady Hysilens: If my sword shows any hesitation...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Don't thank me — thank them instead.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: No, you misunderstand.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: We don't want to see Chrysos Heirs hurt each other. Just give us some time to ask you a few questions.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Then, Mnestia's "golden threads" will judge you and decide your fate.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...As you wish.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: White-haired swordmaster, if what you say is true, then you must know the fate of the world...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: So, how much do you know about what we read from the prophecy?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "You shall shatter into a thousand fragments and wither in the soil of foreign lands."
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: ...Is that correct, Lady Tribbie?
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: How...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: How is this possible...?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: He got it right?
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Yes. But the prophecy never mentioned he'd appear here. At least, not in this era.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: You must listen to me, Aglaea, Tribbie. The Phainon of this world has not yet been born. In a distant future, he will follow the prophecy's guidance and appear before you—
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: But do not seek him out — because "Era Nova" is a complete and utter lie.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The 4,000,001st Eternal Recurrence: Time of Departure
I will tell you the truth, and you will understand why the world must forsake the prophecy and find another path to "Era Nova"...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Because I know both of you, and I believe that no matter how the course of history may change...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The faith we all share will always remain the same.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: And so, the layers of rock began to reverse, and history wove itself anew.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Through my old acquaintances, I was given the chance to meet the leader of the Flame-Chase Journey, Cerydra. And after a long and arduous negotiation, we came to an agreement—
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The Imperator's alliance needed the Destruction, and I was ready to pour all my strength into it. The spoils of the Flame-Chase — the Coreflames — would be sealed by my hand.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: But the condition was this: In the upcoming battle, in our conquest of the "Earth"...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I had to prove that my power could transcend fate.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: In the original history, it was a brutal war. At the end, the Titankin of {RUBY_B#Earth Titan}Georios{RUBY_E#}, Terravox, killed the rampaging Titan and took the Coreflame that supported the earth.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: But this time, Amphoreus encountered a turning point in its fate.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Neither side suffered any losses. When I severed the Titan's head and raised the Coreflame high, the crowd gathered around the scorched remains of the god, roaring with joy...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Cheering for the hero of the Destruction, who had ignited the faint spark of life for the first time.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Yes, in that flickering light, the once-dark path ahead seemed to become clearer.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I proved myself, and in the long years that followed, I brought down the other Titans, one by one.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I could do more than just wait. When time resets, the chance to change the world also emerges from the lines of history...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Until, finally, the brutal future revealed by "Era Nova" is reversed.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: But tell me...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If that's truly the case, why are we doomed to the same outcome?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The people kept their promise and handed you all the Coreflames. In this world, after Tribios, no demigods were born in Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: At this point, I just want to know. When they vanished into the black tide with their mortal bodies...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Why didn't you shed even a single tear?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Your indifference chills me. To you, were they just a bunch of insignificant footnotes?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Sorrow has been my constant companion. In fact, with twelve Coreflames upon me, the fire in my heart has never been more violent...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I'll remember this world through anger. As long as I burn, they'll never truly leave me.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Perhaps... it's already too late.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: But you're right. Anger, at this moment, is the only weapon I can rely on. So...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Draw your sword, executioner! I'll make sure you realize that your greatest mistake was leaving me alive!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: After that, he raised his sword and attacked...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Then, Khaslana killed himself.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: That day, who fell to the sword to be left in the past, and who went into the future? I can't remember anymore.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The 23,570,000th Eternal Recurrence
I only remember a nymph, hiding in the shadows just out of sight, futilely pushing a stone ball...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Climb, fall, climb, fall, climb again, and fall...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The only freedom the nymph had was in choosing how to roll the stone: sometimes fast, sometimes slow, sometimes resting on a gentler slope, leaning against the stone for a break...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: But its choice couldn't change the futility of it all: the stone would always roll back down the slope, and the nymph would always return to the starting point, beginning again.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: After that, every time I reached this point in the cycle, the burning sky would cast a shadow over its path. It would nearly reach the peak at the fourth quint of {RUBY_B#Midnight}Curtain-Fall Hour{RUBY_E#}, then fall to the starting point in the first fifteen seconds of the next {RUBY_B#Dawn}Entry Hour{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: And my efforts in this cycle would dissolve into nothing at the same time.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Absolute nonsense...
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: I thought... "cycles" was the answer you were looking for.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: No, it's just that the answer came so suddenly, there was no fun in tracing it back to its roots.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Aeons? Paths? Hmph, what a load of nonsense.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: I can't give you an exact explanation of those two concepts either.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Enough, I'm just expressing my frustration. Don't you understand? I was already expecting this. "The black tide came from beyond the sky," and everything else is no exception.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Fate is a strange thing: no matter how the details of history change, the Anaxa I know always remains as harsh as ever.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Hmph... If the other Anaxagorases actually worshiped the gods, I'd make sure to find a way to break the cycles to crush them in their cradles—
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Too bad, now only you have the ability to do that.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: What's that supposed to mean? You're willing to help?
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Of course. The Coreflames were meant to save the world, and in my opinion, the noble Titans have no reason to refuse...
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: ...Besides, according to you, before stepping into these endless cycles... you were my pupil.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: I've already heard the same thing countless times...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Enough chitchat. Let's go. If we run into any other scholars, leave them to me.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: We've all made preparations for total annihilation...
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Never thought someone would step in to help.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: You've been to the Luminary Throne before, haven't you?
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Huh? If you're talking about in past cycles...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Heh, you're already much luckier than the other students.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: ...Hold up.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Keep your wits about you... Someone's watching us.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Pretty boy, your eyesight's better than I thought...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: As for that false god who's been turning the world upside down... it's you, isn't it, white-hair?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Heh... you sure do love stealing the spotlight.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: In the name of the Seven Sages, I demand that you immediately step away from the Luminary Throne. This is the sacred ground of "Reason," and no one may desecrate it—
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Take my words back to Aglaea. I won't say the same thing twice, Catgirl.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Oh my, you won't even call me the demigod of "Trickery"? That is just heartbreaking.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I have some words for you too: First, as one of the most heretical blasphemers in the world, you have no right to lecture me. Second...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: This is none of your business, Grove boy. Step aside, I don't want anyone getting hurt.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Here we go... again.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Coreflame thieves... You really think you can scare off a Sage of the Grove with nothing but empty threats?
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Heh, heh, heh... This gloomy little brat's got a sharp tongue!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Not bad, not bad, I kind of like you. As a return favor, I'll feast on {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#}' Coreflame right here—
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Don't cry now! Heh, heh, heh—
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Phew, that was close... I'm outta here!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: They're exactly like all the past ones I've known...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Cunning... and yet so naive.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Sounds like you have a plan?
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Of course. When I first set out on the Flame-Chase Journey, Lady Tribbie never managed to teach me Oronyx's Miracle...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: ...But along the way, I learned a thing or two.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Where... Where are you going?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I... I don't know?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Heh, the Venerationists' foolish inventions finally come in handy.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Huff... Huff... How is this possible?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: The ???th Eternal Recurrence: End
You've arrived, {RUBY_B#Trickery Titan}Zagreus{RUBY_E#}... Always so punctual.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Wh—What? Do you know who I am?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: I'm running out of patience, so I'm not going to waste words. Listen up, Spirithief: Hand over the Coreflame, and let's pretend we never clashed. This way, you and this world can still be saved.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Heh, heh, heh, "save"? You sing better than any bard!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: If you ask me... you're the greatest disaster Amphoreus has ever known!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: No matter how strong you are, you're still just a mortal body! Carrying twelve Coreflames? Don't make me laugh! You'll just get consumed by the divine flames, and drag this world down with you...
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: ...One hundred thirty-four.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: What...
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: This is the 134th cycle I've lived through. And the number of Coreflames I carry is...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The 1st Eternal Recurrence: End
...Yes.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: A thousand Coreflames, and just a single Chrysos Heir... How is that even possible!?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: I've come this far, and that's proof enough.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: But someday... you will burn to the ground.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Of course, the divine flames will eventually consume my eyes and blind me...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: But before that, they could still forge and sharpen Dawnmaker. Now, when I cut open your stomach, you won't feel a thing.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: You... you...
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: This is the final warning.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Heh, heh... Fine, fine...
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Assume this world holds a hundred million possibilities, and no matter how one looks at it, ninety-nine million, nine hundred ninety-nine thousand, nine hundred and ninety-nine of them all point to outcomes of certain Destruction...
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Even so, I'll use my divine power, despised by the people of this world, to achieve that one-in-a-hundred-million possibility...
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: ...Bartholos!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Brat... if you've got the guts, you'll have to first step over my dead body!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Heh, how absurd...
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: In my memories, {RUBY_B#Trickery Titan}Zagreus{RUBY_E#} always meets the same end, over and over again...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Their departure no longer stirs anything in my heart.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: This "Reason" Coreflame before us is a fake, obvious as day.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Ah... I know.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I know. It always plays out like this. The Spirithief covers for her, and the "Trickery" demigod escapes with two Coreflames...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: ...And then, driven by defiance, or hatred, she decides to stand before me once more.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Exactly like the countless past hers I've known... cunning, yet so naive.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Since you've witnessed this same scene play out countless times, tell me...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Will you carve the "Trickery" Coreflame from my chest now?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...That depends on your attitude. At least so far, in the cycles where you've asked this question... the endings haven't been so cruel.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Heh... well, thank you for that. But I also believe that this time, you won't catch up to me—
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: No one can catch up to me. I'm no longer running to escape anymore.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Whether you believe me or not, I'll still tell you this: You've made the wrong decision.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Alright, then, we'll see—
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Silence.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Ah... this is new.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: ...One-eyed boy, what are you trying to pull now?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Go, Cifera. Give us some time in private.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: This isn't for her, but for you.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: You've walked too far down this path. It's time to discuss a possibility: Maybe the road you're walking is not one of salvation, but one that will simply drag the world into the flames.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: For old times' sake, turn back. I don't care how many times you've tried, because there's one thing I'm sure of—
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Your messiah complex has turned you into something no different from the icy gods you spoke of. The children of humanity you swore to save... they are no more than ants to you now, aren't they?
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Heh, of course.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: {M#He'll}{F#She'll} be able to walk further down the path of Deliverance than a fire that only knows how to burn.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I've been wondering, what kind of demon could burn my homeland to the ground in an instant, without batting an eye...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Now, I have the answer. It turns out that fiery demon has been fantasizing of becoming this world's Deliverer!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I don't want to argue anymore. No matter what I say, the outcome won't change.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Make your biggest effort to resist, or accept fate and hand over the Coreflame to me...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Even if it's futile, you... we all have the right to choose.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Yes, even if it is futile, and the world is just a divine joke...
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: When I walk into the "Destruction" written by the gods with my own two legs, you will witness—
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Even the smallest footnote still leaves a mark in the story!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: The 134th Eternal Recurrence
And so, at the end of the 134th cycle...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The "Traveler" and the "Scholar" fulfilled their fates once again.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Or perhaps, it wasn't just they who fulfilled their fates. I can't quite remember all this.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: In the endless darkness, for no reason, a voice always lingered by my ear...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: "Losses are a constant on the Flame-Chase journey, among which even life itself holds little value."
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: "Reduced to ashes"... Such a familiar end.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: It happens in every journey, always the same.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I, the last son of Gorgo, the demigod of "Strife," salute you—
rows.speaker: Mydeimos, Lance of Fury

rows.text: I'll give ten thousand scars and ten thousand lives of mine to fuel the blazing sun of deliverance!
rows.speaker: Mydeimos, Lance of Fury

rows.text: In your next life, I shall once again block your path...
rows.speaker: Mydeimos, Lance of Fury

rows.text: Deliverer... I wish you... eternal victory.
rows.speaker: Mydeimos, Lance of Fury

rows.text: The 108,642nd Coreflame of "Strife" fell into the fire...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Yet the shadows of the black tide still loomed, and pain and despair spread across distant lands...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The blaze was still not enough. It had to be fed...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The 33,550,336th Eternal Recurrence
Even if it meant... burning this body to ash.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: No matter how bright the sun is, there are still places it cannot reach.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Moreover, the sun you bear is both cold and blinding...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: A sun like that... surely cannot bring warmth to the nether realm of the next life.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Golden blood... is born from the Destruction. We have long since lost the right to seek warmth.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Only by... feeding the flames... can we melt... that hopeless future.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Allow me to ask: How many Coreflames do you carry now?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Twenty-four million... forty-one thousand... one hundred and eighty-three.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: ...Such a heavy burden.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: So that's why you've turned into this, a broken idol... tragic firewood.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: No matter... I will bear this burden.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: As long as... you hand over the Coreflame of Death.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I must refuse. As the demigod of "Death"...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I cannot watch you walk into a fate more cruel than "Death."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: But this way, the past, present, and future...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Will never again suffer... unnecessary death.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: You finally found {M#him.}{F#her.}
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Unnecessary death...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Indeed, you are not the Phainon I know.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Please turn back. Don't let that absurd and unjust fate of yours come to pass. This way, at least my realm... can still become the fragrant bed where you fall asleep.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: In the end, still...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: It seems the clash of blades was inevitable.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: ...How painful.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I know I am not your match, having fallen under your sword countless times — but even so, please understand that my resolve is not to be underestimated.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Even {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#} cannot shape all things at will, nor can they dictate the fate of all life. No one can shoulder the balance of life and death alone, not even a god.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: And it is precisely for this reason that I chose, at the end of this arduous journey, to overcome the trial and take the authority of "Death"...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I am the Hand of Shadow, Castorice, the demigod of Death. Listen closely, Deliverer from days past—
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: What...?
rows.speaker: Castorice, Hand of Shadow

rows.text: The Coreflame of Death was taken from the dragon's belly. What a brilliant flame.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: It should shine upon all, light the path ahead, and illuminate the dawn of Amphoreus that's to come...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Two million three thousand four hundred and thirty-two cycles...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Twenty-four million forty-one thousand one hundred and eighty-four Coreflames...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: As if even the deepest abyss of primordial chaos could be burned away.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: You're here, as always.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: ...You're still lingering deep within me, never fading away?
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Because you haven't completely abandoned hope, am I right?
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: You're still waiting for a miracle, for the true hero to come and save us.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: If that thread of hope exists, it must come from beyond this world, from the true starry sky...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: But... if it's just a traveler with no connection to Amphoreus, they may not understand our struggles, nor be willing to join this fight.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Your thoughts... are wavering. The mark of Destruction is deepening...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: But even within the gods' cold calculations, unconditional courage and goodwill still emerge. So...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Never forget what set you on this path.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: How many times has it been? Remind me again... My memory is a bit fuzzy.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Four million... exactly.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: ...Then that blaze inside of you must be burning hotter than ever.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Heh, yes... When I first forged the twelve Coreflames into one, I had the same impression.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The Destruction... A power unlike anything before surged within me. Violent flames, ready to tear my body apart and consume this world, this wretched prison. I thought that was it... the ultimate power, which nothing could surpass.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: And yet now, this fragile body holds a staggering forty-eight million Coreflames... I suppose it won't be long — perhaps just a fleeting ten thousand years — before it's reduced to nothing but {RUBY_B#Flame Reaver}charred, crumbling bones{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: And when that happens, your long struggle will finally come to an end.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: ...No. I've already found a way to keep the cycles going.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Mind sharing it with me?
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: In every new cycle, a new me is born.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: All I have to do is push the next Phainon to the end of the world. And then...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Then he'll kill me. Shatter this body... take my flames, my memories, and carry on the path I started.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Bold plan. But risky. What if, one day, the next you refuses to follow the same path?
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: How can you ensure the continuation of the cycles?
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: If it were Professor Anaxa or Aglaea in my place, maybe they'd come up with something smarter.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Unfortunately, I don't have a backup plan. I have no choice but to bet everything on the next Phainon... and trust that he makes the same choice I did.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: But even in this wretched prison, luck is still sometimes on my side. Because...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I never forget what set me on this path.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Wait, you mean...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Ever since I committed to this plan...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: ...Not once, in millions of cycles, has there ever been an exception.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I can do this... Lord Phainon.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: As the demigod of the Sky, a healer of Twilight Courtyard, I will heal you. And then...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The black tide... it's consuming you. You can't hold out much longer... demigod.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Hand over the Coreflame. Let's put an end to this suffering.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Ha... now that just won't do...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: A healer should stay composed in front of those suffering from illness, shouldn't they?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Hyacinthia...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I swear, your deaths won't be in vain...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Just as they have never been.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I believe in you... You are the Chrysos Heir of Worldbearing, the one who can lead us... lead this world...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: It's just... I don't understand. Within the sun upon your shoulders...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The part of that warmth that should come from you... from an ordinary person... it's so faint.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: My humanity is indeed just a flicker compared to the blazing fire of divinity.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Even so... don't cast it away.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I... never have.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I have kept everyone's wishes close to my heart.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Even though the divine fire burns so fiercely that, every time I return to the start, it devours me in an instant...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Each cycle, it's your wishes that guide me to the end... that pass the flames to the next me.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Over and over... and over again.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: So, you're not just a lone spark in the dark... You're a pyre built from the bones of all the selves you've left behind.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But... what about you?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: What about your wishes... the wishes of all the countless versions of you?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Ah...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Lord Khaslana... so that's how it is...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I knew it was you ♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It's that déjà vu~♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hmm... There's something oddly unfamiliar about this.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: After everything you've been through, how about some well-deserved rest? Time flows ever so slowly in Aedes Elysiae — and as long as you wish, we'll still have plenty of quiet moments ahead...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "Without flaw"... That is the flaw the golden blood gave you, the most fatal flaw of all, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The moment you took the world upon your shoulders without hesitation...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You lost the chance to ever be yourself.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Now that... is an unexpected revelation.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Then I suppose... that makes me the perfect fuel for the flame of Deliverance, doesn't it?
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: No...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: An empty flame saves no one...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But... I still believe in you, Deliverer.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I, Hyacinthia, the Eye of Twilight... am neither strong enough to command the wind and rain, nor willing to end this absurd struggle by letting the sky fall.
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: The only thing I can do... is become one with the sky itself. And then...
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: May the gentle colors of the rainbow paint your sun in shades it has never known...
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: May they bring Amphoreus... a rosy-fingered dawn.
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: Yes, your sun burns hot enough to turn everything to ash...
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: But tell me. How will the seeds of a new world... ever take root?
rows.speaker: Hyacinthia, Eye of Twilight

rows.text: The Coreflame rose. The sky fell. The 23,570,000th cycle came to an end.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: And this time... the end of the Flame-Chase...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Remained the same as ever.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: From the horizon rose a golden color unlike anything the world had ever seen. So pure, it consumed all in its path.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: This was the end of the world... and the start of the next...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: For a moment, I saw the Destruction of the universe.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: That being known as Irontomb... its will to break free from the black tide burns fiercer than the blazing sun...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Is this Amphoreus's wrath? If its choice has already been made, if fate is set in stone...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: I will still never yield to it...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: No more chasing is needed. And now, I am the fire at the end of the long night.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: The Flame-Chase isn't some quiet walk through a sea of flowers. It's a revolution, an all-consuming transformation. And if Destruction is the only way...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Then let me be the one to step across the ashes of the old world and burn endlessly...
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: Until another dawn rises on the distant horizon, bringing the true dawn to Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Khaslana

rows.text: This is the cycle you're about to enter.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Countless memories... are flooding in.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Countless versions of myself... have stood here, facing the same choice.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: They all needed a moment, just like you do, to stop, to breathe, to process the weight of a million lifetimes' worth of sorrow, pain, and struggle.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: And just like them, you will carry those memories and that fire... into the chaos of rebirth.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: I must go... and bear this burden.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I must say goodbye to you... and then fight the Destruction with Destruction.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Yes. That's always the decision you make.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: I will burn... and fade away. I will become the Flame Reaver of this life and keep my promise to Cyrene.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I will kill gods and comrades alike and steal the Coreflames. And even if my mind turns to ash along with my body, I will keep my purpose in mind...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I will stop Era Nova. I will find the next me... and make him carry on this futile endeavor of thirty million lifetimes.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Looks like you're ready.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Then I should be going, too.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: That's it! [Trailblazer] warned me about this place, right before Qlipoth glimpsed {M#him...}{F#her...}
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Where... are you going?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You only exist in my heart. There's nowhere else for you to go.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Do you remember what she said? The dreams you had as children? The Deliverer in the prophecies? A real, living, breathing person...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: [Trailblazer]...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I see. You were there all along...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I don't have an answer for that, my friend...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...I'm sorry. I was supposed to send you home. This is my Flame-Chase Journey. You were never meant to be a part of it...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: No. You know the truth. If Irontomb is {RUBY_B#completed}born{RUBY_E#} from Amphoreus's fate, then it will bring ruin to the worlds beyond the sky. And all these countless lifetimes you've spent...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: It's all been for the sake of defying that end... hasn't it?
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: In millions of cycles, I've said goodbye to each and every one of you, yet nothing ever changes.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Each time we speak, our words grow fewer. Your fire burns hotter, and you're getting closer... to becoming pure rage, a vessel of hatred.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: I... never had a choice.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I understand. If you are to keep the worst fate from unfolding, this is the only path.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: But this time... things are different. Your persistence has shifted the tide. On the horizon, I see it, faint but undeniable, the shape of dawn, breaking through the eternal night.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: ...Turns out, the fire that lights the way was never mine to begin with.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Do you remember? In that first timeline, you and Mydeimos stood before the Scales of Justice, locked in a "duel," each of you weighing what you held dearest, "what weighed more than the fate of the world."
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: And when hesitation took hold, the answer you sought from me...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: ...What am I saying? I am you. Even if you buried me deep and chose another path, that fact never changed.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Then let's try again. When you stood before the scales in hesitation, the answer you found in your own heart...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Do you still remember it?
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Remember the past, and become the hero of tomorrow.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What weighs more than the fate of the world is the resolve to shoulder an immutable past, and carry it into the future.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Good. Then, [Trailblazer], my friend, my comrade...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: You arrived in this strange world and were bound by its cruel fate up till this very moment.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: In the face of danger, you never once backed down. Instead, you've saved world after world, without hesitation. That boarding pass on your chest... is now the mark of a hero.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: If I choose to step through that door and embrace an end fitting of the Destruction, let this sun forged from millions and millions of Coreflames burn me up along with the god of Destruction and THEIR minions...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Then the world we leave behind, this world, my home, where hope still lingers...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: Will you take on everything we've carried, return to the beginning one last time, stop the {RUBY_B#completion}birth{RUBY_E#} of Irontomb, save the world we love, and rewrite its doomed fate?
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: ...Good. In that case, even this fruitless wasteland may finally bloom with flowers.
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: So...
rows.speaker: The Hero Within

rows.text: If [Trailblazer] takes on the weight of the whole world...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: One will step into the future...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: One will remain in the past.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If I can strike down the gods with Dawnmaker, perhaps fate's deadlock can be broken.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: And if you can stop Irontomb from ever {RUBY_B#completion}being born{RUBY_E#}... then these thirty million cycles will have not been in vain.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It's time to put our teamwork to the test, partner.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Thank you for all you've done already, friend.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The image of the hero I've buried deep in my heart... finally steps into the light — here, at the end of this long Flame-Chase Journey...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Cyrene. A page never seen before has just been turned.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Lend me the power of Time and send this hero back to the origin of time, back to your side...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: And I will walk the unfinished path... just like the countless versions of me before, unwavering as always.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Wake up...
Wake up... [Trailblazer]... Wake up...!
Phew... You're finally awake. That's a relief...
We were so close to being swept away by the reverse flow of time! It's lucky we found a safe place.
Now, I'm going to send you back to the very start of "Time." But before we part, there's something I need to tell you. Something very, very important...
That's right! At this very moment, my memories are finally whole!
After watching so many fragments, my past is finally coming into focus, little by little. [Trailblazer], you're smart. You must have a clue now.
Or maybe...
You knew the answer long ago, didn't you?
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: Not surprised at all, huh? That's because I'm simple at heart. No matter what form I take, I've always been true to myself.
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: But I'm glad that I remembered in the end. This way, I'll have no regrets.
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: Don't worry. We're not truly parting, because I'm going to become a part of you...
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: I'll turn into the memory of this cycle, the 33,550,336th Flame-Chase Journey, and forever reside in the heart of the "Time" demigod.
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: This way, you'll carry all that has come before, crossing time itself to reach the next cycle.
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: My mission ends here, but looking back, I still feel lucky...
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: After all, across thirty million Cyrenes, I was the first and the only one who got to finally meet you!
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: So, believe me, in the next cycle, there will be another Cyrene waiting for you.
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: And in the one after that, and the one after that... I will always, always be waiting.
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: ... Saying all that, I can finally fade away in peace... and become a part of [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: Without even realizing it, we'd already taken a wonderful journey together, all the way to the world's end.
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: Now, take my hand, say a brief farewell, and step forward into tomorrow.
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: Go find the future Cyrene, and set out on another journey with her. Promise me, you won't keep me waiting too long, okay?
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: Hehe... No need to say it out loud. This is enough for me.
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: It's time to go, my dear friend. May your Trailblazing journey always be accompanied by a cool breeze and rippling waves...
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie

rows.text: And may the days ahead embrace you like the softest fluff, forever warm, forever gentle!
rows.speaker: Ripples of Past Reverie
